title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Website & Email Marketing Manager
description:
Website &
 Marketing Manager



Squarespace | HubSpot | HTML/CSS/JavaScript | Technical SEO

Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term



About Us



We are a small, family-owned business looking for a Website &
 Marketing Manager to become an important part of our team for years to come.



This is not an agency role where you will manage random tasks for many different clients. You will work directly with the owners and our small marketing team to help grow one business with care, consistency, and long-term thinking.



We already have a dedicated social content team focused on short-form video, graphics, captions, publishing, and visual storytelling.



Our Growth Marketing Manager focuses on growth strategy, Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO strategy, funnel strategy, analytics, reporting, and optimization recommendations.



Your role is to own our website and
 marketing execution. You will develop, edit, build, publish, test, track, and continually improve our website pages, blog posts, landing pages,
 programs, forms, workflows, automations, and customer journey messaging.



Our
 programs are currently supported in HubSpot, so experience building
s, workflows, lists, forms, segments, and dashboards in HubSpot is important.



This is not a social content creation role and it is not a graphic design role. We work with a designer on a project basis when needed. Your focus is website,
, HubSpot, copy execution, technical SEO implementation, QA, tracking, dashboards, and ongoing improvement.



About the Role



Our website is built in Squarespace. Our forms,
 programs, workflows, lead nurturing, tracking, and dashboards are currently managed through HubSpot.



This is not simply a publishing role.



You are responsible for turning business priorities, campaign goals, SEO direction, customer journey needs, notes, offers, and ideas into clear, polished, functional website and
 experiences.



The Growth Marketing Manager may identify content opportunities, SEO priorities, campaign needs,
 flow gaps, audience segments, and conversion opportunities based on data and performance.



From there, you own the execution.



Sometimes you may receive a full draft. Other times you may receive notes, a goal, an offer, a keyword, or a customer question that needs to be addressed. Your job is to turn that direction into strong website or
 copy that is clear, accurate, on-brand, conversion-focused, built correctly, tested, tracked, and ready to publish.



We do not view our website as something that gets redesigned every few years. We view it as a living product that should be continually improved, tested, refined, measured, and optimized.



How This Role Fits With the Team



Social Content Team owns: short-form video, social posts, captions, graphics, and publishing.



Growth Marketing Manager owns: growth strategy, SEO strategy, paid ads, funnel recommendations, analytics, and performance direction.



Website &
 Marketing Manager owns: website and
 execution, copy development, publishing, HubSpot builds, technical SEO implementation, QA, tracking, dashboards, and ongoing improvements.



Together, these roles create a complete marketing system where content builds awareness, growth marketing drives qualified traffic, and your work converts and nurtures that traffic into customers.



Responsibilities



Website &
 Copy

 • Develop website and
 copy from strategy, notes, drafts, AI-assisted copy, campaign goals, SEO direction, or owner direction

 • Write and edit landing page copy, website sections, FAQs, blog posts, and
 campaigns

 • Turn rough ideas, offers, keywords, or customer questions into polished website and
 copy

 • Create
 subject lines, preview text, headlines, body copy, buttons, and calls to action

 • Improve website and
 copy for clarity, SEO, readability, and conversion

 • Maintain consistency across website pages, FAQs, policies, offers,
 flows, and calls to action

 • Flag content that feels unclear, outdated, inconsistent, duplicated, inaccurate, or off-brand



Squarespace Website Management

 • Build, update, and maintain pages in Squarespace

 • Publish and format website pages, blog posts, landing pages, and FAQs

 • Implement custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when needed

 • Build custom website sections beyond Squarespace’s standard editor

 • Create polished landing pages for campaigns, events, promotions, and lead generation

 • Improve mobile responsiveness, navigation, layout, and user experience

 • Optimize calls to action and conversion paths

 • Troubleshoot website issues and bugs

 • Write clean, organized, responsive code that can be maintained over time

 • Test custom code before publishing



Blog Publishing & SEO Content



The Growth Marketing Manager may recommend blog topics, keywords, and content opportunities based on SEO strategy. Your role is to develop, publish, optimize, polish, and maintain that content.



Responsibilities include:

 • Develop blog content from approved topics, notes, drafts, keywords, customer questions, or AI-assisted copy

 • Edit blog content for clarity, structure, SEO, readability, and conversion

 • Publish blog articles in Squarespace

 • Add internal links, optimized images, alt text, meta titles, and meta descriptions

 • Use custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when needed to create more polished blog layouts

 • Implement Article schema when appropriate

 • Refresh and maintain existing blog content over time



You are not expected to own the full SEO content strategy. The Growth Marketing Manager may identify the search opportunity, topic, keyword, or funnel need. You should be able to develop and improve the actual website and blog copy from that direction.



Technical SEO Implementation

 • Implement on-page SEO updates

 • Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, image alt text, internal links, and URL structure

 • Implement redirects when needed

 • Improve crawlability and indexing

 • Support page speed and Core Web Vitals improvements where possible

 • Compress and optimize images before publishing

 • Implement schema markup and structured data, including Local Business, Organization, Event, FAQ, Article, and Breadcrumb schema

 • Review Google Search Console issues and support fixes when needed



Website QA & Content Consistency

 • Regularly audit the website to ensure content is accurate, current, and consistent

 • Review FAQs to ensure answers are accurate and aligned across the site

 • Check that pricing, policies, room details, event information, contact information, and calls to action are consistent

 • Identify broken links, formatting issues, missing images, mobile issues, and user experience problems

 • Maintain a running website improvement backlog

 • QA every website update across desktop, tablet, and mobile before publishing

 • Confirm forms, links, tracking, and HubSpot connections work correctly after updates



 Program & HubSpot Automation



You will help build and maintain a thoughtful
 program currently supported in HubSpot, not just send occasional newsletters.



The
 program should support the full customer journey, including first inquiry, follow-up, nurture, booking, event attendance, re-engagement, and future opportunities.



Responsibilities include:

 • Build and maintain
 programs currently supported in HubSpot

 • Create
 campaigns, nurture sequences, confirmation
s, RSVP flows, promotional
s, newsletters, and re-engagement
s

 • Build the supporting HubSpot workflows, lists, forms, segments, and dashboards needed to track and improve performance

 • Segment lists in HubSpot based on source, behavior, customer type, lifecycle stage, and engagement

 • Manage HubSpot forms and connect them to the correct lists, workflows, thank-you pages, and follow-up steps

 • Test
 formatting, links, buttons, personalization tokens, forms, lists, workflow logic, and enrollment criteria

 • Monitor
 performance and recommend improvements



HubSpot Tracking, Dashboards & Reporting



We need our website and
 activity tracked clearly in HubSpot so we can understand where leads come from, what they engage with, and how they move through the customer journey.



Responsibilities include:

 • Make sure website forms are properly connected to HubSpot

 • Track form submissions by source, page, campaign, and customer type

 • Ensure landing pages, thank-you pages,
s, and workflows are connected correctly

 • Support HubSpot tracking for website activity,
 engagement, and lead behavior

 • Help set up lead source tracking and attribution where possible

 • Build and maintain HubSpot lists, segments, and dashboards

 • Track
 open rates, click rates, form submissions, workflow performance, and conversion activity

 • Work with the Growth Marketing Manager to make sure reporting data is clean, useful, and actionable

 • Flag gaps where tracking is missing, broken, unclear, or not useful



Campaign & Launch Support



For campaigns, events, seasonal promotions, wedding showcases, offers, or new experiences, you will help build the digital infrastructure and messaging needed to support the launch.



This may include:

 • Campaign landing pages

 • Landing page copy

 • HubSpot forms

 • Thank-you pages

 • Confirmation
s

 • Automated follow-up sequences

 • Website banners

 • Event RSVP flows

 • Tracking links and UTM parameters

 • Post-campaign
 follow-up



Reporting



Each week, you will provide a concise update covering:

 • Website updates completed

 • Landing pages built

 • Blog posts published

 • Website copy improved

 •
 copy developed

 •
 campaigns launched

 •
 sequences built or improved

 • HubSpot workflows created or improved

 • HubSpot forms created or improved

 • HubSpot tracking or dashboard updates

 • Website issues identified and fixed

 • SEO and schema updates implemented

 • Form submissions and form conversion performance

 •
 open rates and click-through rates

 • Landing page performance

 • Recommendations for future improvements



We do not want simple task updates only. We want thoughtful recommendations.



Who We Are Looking For



This is not an entry-level role.



The ideal person is:

 • Self-driven

 • Detail-oriented

 • Organized

 • Analytical

 • Comfortable working independently

 • Strong at writing and editing website and
 copy

 • Comfortable turning rough ideas into polished digital content

 • Comfortable building
 programs, workflows, lists, forms, and dashboards in HubSpot

 • Skilled at website publishing, QA, and troubleshooting

 • Resourceful and able to figure things out

 • Someone who comes with solutions, not just problems

 • Someone who takes pride in polished, production-ready work



We care a lot about quality. Website speed matters. Mobile experience matters.
 quality matters. Copy clarity matters. Form functionality matters. Tracking matters. Dashboard accuracy matters.



Sloppy work, broken layouts, missed details, poor formatting, messy code, weak copy, broken tracking, unclear dashboards, or needing constant reminders are not a good fit for how we operate.



Required Experience



Applicants must have hands-on experience with:

 • Squarespace

 • HTML

 • CSS

 • JavaScript

 • HubSpot Marketing Hub

 • HubSpot forms

 • HubSpot
 campaigns

 • HubSpot workflows

 • HubSpot lists and segmentation

 • HubSpot reporting or dashboards

 copywriting or editing

 QA



Bonus Experience

 • Local SEO

 • Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, or similar tools

 • Hospitality, travel, events, or wedding industry experience

 • Experience improving lead generation websites

 • Experience building
 nurture sequences

 • Experience with lead source attribution

 • Experience working with AI-assisted marketing workflows



What Success Looks Like



Success means:

 • Website pages are polished, accurate, and easy to use

 • Website copy is clear, helpful, and conversion-focused

 • Blog content is developed, published, and optimized well

 • FAQs and website content stay accurate and consistent

 program exists and improves over time

 workflows launch smoothly

 performance can be measured in HubSpot

 • Dashboards show what is working and what needs attention

 • Technical SEO improvements are implemented

 • More visitors become qualified inquiries

 • The website and
 experience improves month after month



Compensation



Starting salary: $700–$900 USD per month, depending on experience, with opportunities for performance-based increases as you grow with the company.



How to Apply



Please include:

 • Your experience with Squarespace, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HubSpot, technical SEO, website copy,
 copy, HubSpot workflows, and HubSpot dashboards

 campaigns, workflows, or

 copy you have written or improved

Application Exercise

title: Full Time Accountant (Xero), Long Term, Crypto a Plus
description:
We're a growing Australian business (a regulated Virtual Asset Service Provider) seeking a meticulous full time accountant to own our books long term. This is a permanent, ongoing role, not a project. The role starts with a full historical cleanup and audit of expenses (roughly the first 1 to 2 months), then moves into ongoing monthly accounting. Our books must be ready for annual external audit, so accuracy matters more than speed. We want a balance of experience — not the most senior person, but confident enough to work independently. Most importantly: proactive and assertive. You spot when something looks wrong, dig in, and raise it, rather than just processing what you're given. You always look for ways to make our processes cleaner and more efficient.



MUST HAVES

- 3 to 5+ years hands-on accounting experience

- Advanced Xero skills (this is our core platform)

- Strong fundamentals: reconciliations, payroll, month end, financial statements

- Great attention to detail and clear written English

- Available Monday to Friday, 8am to 4pm Philippine time (matches Australian business hours), about 36 hours per week, with every other Friday OFF

- Comfortable handling sensitive financial data with discretion



NICE TO HAVES (we're happy to teach the right person)

- Australian GST/BAS knowledge

- Crypto/digital asset experience (exchanges, wallets, on-chain activity)

- Familiarity with Koinly or CoinTracking

- CPA/CA qualification



WORKING HOURS

Monday to Friday, 8am to 4pm PH time, with every other Friday off.



TO APPLY, please answer:

1. Briefly describe your Xero experience and the types of businesses you've supported.

2. Do you have any crypto or digital asset accounting experience?

3. What's the first thing you check when a bank feed won't reconcile?

4. How would you suggest an improvement if you disagreed with an existing process?



We review every genuine application. Generic copy-paste applications will be skipped.

title: Amaaon FBA Product Sourcing VA (OA, A2A, Wholesale)
description:
# Amazon FBA Product Sourcing Virtual Assistant



## About Us



We are a fast-growing UK-based Amazon FBA business focused on sourcing profitable products through Online Arbitrage (OA) and Wholesale. We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant who is motivated, eager to learn, and committed to helping us grow.



## Responsibilities



* Source profitable products for Amazon FBA using Online Arbitrage and Wholesale methods.

* Analyse products using Keepa, SellerAmp SAS (SAS), and the Amazon Seller App.

* Ensure products meet our sourcing criteria, including:



  * Strong profit margins and ROI.

  * Consistent sales history.

  * Healthy Buy Box rotation.

  * Low risk of IP complaints or account issues.

  * Reliable suppliers.

* Create and maintain organised buy lists.

* Identify replenishable products with long-term potential.

* Research new suppliers and wholesale opportunities.

* Monitor pricing and stock levels when required.

* Communicate regularly with the team and provide daily sourcing updates.



## Requirements



* Previous Amazon FBA sourcing experience (preferred).

* Experience with SellerAmp SAS, Keepa, and Google Sheets/Excel.

* Strong analytical and research skills.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Good written English and communication skills.

* Reliable internet connection and ability to meet deadlines.

* Honest, trustworthy, and proactive.



## Preferred Experience



* Online Arbitrage (essential).

* Wholesale sourcing (preferred).

* Knowledge of Amazon UK marketplace.

* Experience using tools such as Keepa, SellerAmp SAS, BuyBotPro, or similar.



## What We're Looking For



We value quality over quantity. We want someone who can consistently find profitable, low-risk products that fit our sourcing criteria rather than simply submitting large numbers of leads.



This is a long-term opportunity with room for increased responsibilities and pay as the business grows. We are looking for someone who wants to become part of our team and grow alongside us.



## How to Apply



Please include:



* Your Amazon FBA experience.

* The sourcing tools you use.

* How many profitable leads you typically find per day.

* Examples of products you have successfully sourced (if possible).

* Your hourly rate or expected monthly salary.

* The word **"Harbour"** at the beginning of your application so we know you have read the entire job description.

title: Chat Intake Training Manager
description:
About Juvo Leads

Juvo Leads is one of the fastest-growing live chat and legal intake companies in the United States. For more than 11 years, we have helped law firms connect with prospective clients through live chat, inbound call handling, appointment scheduling, and intake services.



Our primary focus is serving law firms nationwide, helping them create exceptional first impressions and convert more qualified prospects into clients.



While much of the industry continues to move toward automation, AI, and chatbots, our philosophy remains simple:

Butts in Seats. Not Bots in the Cloud.



We believe that when someone is searching for legal help, they deserve to interact with a real person. Every conversation we handle is powered by a trained human tea
mber—not artificial intelligence. Our commitment to genuine human interaction is what sets us apart and has fueled our growth for more than a decade.



As we continue to expand, we're building a world-class remote workforce capable of delivering exceptional service at scale. We are looking for leaders who are passionate about developing people, improving performance, and creating systems that help employees succeed.



If you're excited about building high-performing remote teams, developing talent, and creating measurable business impact through training and coaching, we'd love to meet you.



Overview

We are seeking a Training Manager to own the onboarding, development, certification, and ongoing education of our remote chat agent workforce. This role is responsible for ensuring every new hire receives a consistent, high-quality training experience and is fully prepared to succeed in production.



The Training Manager will design and deliver training programs, oversee agent readiness, partner with Operations and Quality teams to address performance gaps, and continuously improve learning initiatives that drive quality, efficiency, and client outcomes. This position is accountable not only for training delivery, but for the measurable success of agents after training.



The ideal candidate has experience building and managing remote training programs, coaching adult learners, developing curriculum, and creating scalable processes that support rapid organizational growth.



 Key Responsibilities: 



New Hire Training & Onboarding

  * Own the end-to-end onboarding and training experience for all new chat agents.

  * Design and deliver structured onboarding programs that prepare agents for legal intake and live chat responsibilities.

  * Ensure all new hires complete training, certification, and graduation requirements within established timelines.

  * Conduct readiness assessments and certify agents before transition to production teams.

  * Facilitate seamless handoffs between Training, Operations, and Quality teams.



Training Program Development

  * Design, implement, and continuously improve training programs for new and existing agents.

  * Develop lesson plans, training materials, SOPs, assessments, simulations, certifications, and knowledge base content.

  * Ensure training content remains current, accurate, and aligned with operational processes and client requirements.

  * Create scalable training systems capable of supporting company growth and new client launches.

  * Incorporate adult learning principles and instructional design best practices into all training initiatives.



Coaching & Employee Development

  * Deliver engaging virtual training sessions using a variety of learning methods and technologies.

  * Provide coaching, mentorship, and developmental feedback to employees throughout their tenure.

  * Partner with supervisors to identify employee skill gaps and create targeted development plans.

  * Build refresher training, continuing education, and performance improvement programs.

  * Support career growth initiatives, internal promotions, and leadership development pathways.



Performance Assessment & Quality Improvement

  * Develop evaluation tools to measure trainee comprehension, readiness, and performance.

  * Track post-training performance to evaluate training effectiveness.

  * Analyze quality trends, recurring errors, and operational performance metrics to identify training opportunities.

  * Collaborate with Quality Assurance and Operations teams to reduce performance gaps and improve outcomes.

  * Ensure retraining initiatives are deployed quickly when performance concerns emerge. 



Collaboration & Program Management

  * Partner closely with Operations Leadership, Quality Assurance, and Client Services teams.

  * Support new client launches, process updates, script changes, and system enhancements through training initiatives.

  * Maintain accurate reporting on training completion, certifications, graduation rates, retention, and performance outcomes.

  * Establish best practices for knowledge transfer, coaching, documentation, and employee development.

  * Build and manage scalable training processes as the company continues to grow.



 Qualifications 



  Required 

  * Bachelor's degree in Education, Training & Development, Communications, Psychology, Business, Human Resources, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.

  * Minimum 3 years of experience designing, delivering, and managing training programs in a fully remote environment with 50-100 employees. 

  * Proven experience onboarding, coaching, developing, and upskilling remote employees with teams of 50-100. 

  * Experience creating and maintaining virtual training curricula, certification programs, assessments, knowledge bases, SOPs, and continuing education programs.

  * Experience using remote training and knowledge management platforms such as Trainual, NotebookLM, Loom, Google Workspace, LMS platforms, testing tools, and virtual meeting software.

  * Experience in Live chat, Customer Service, Legal Intake, Contact Center Operations, Sales, Appointment Setting, or other performance-driven environments in the U.S. market. 

  * Strong understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, coaching techniques, and performance management.

  * Demonstrated ability to provide performance coaching, career development guidance, and individualized improvement plans.

  * Experience partnering with Quality Assurance and Operations teams to identify skill gaps and implement training solutions.

  * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

  * Strong organizational, project management, and time management skills.

  * Ability to simplify complex concepts into engaging, actionable, and measurable learning experiences.

  * Data-driven mindset with experience using performance metrics, quality scores, and operational KPIs to evaluate training effectiveness.

  * Experience working with cross-functional, multinational teams supporting U.S.-based clients. 



 Preferred 

  * Experience in Legal Intake, Law Firm Operations, Legal Marketing, or Legal terminology.

  * Experience training and coaching remote teams in Live Chat, Customer Service, Contact Center, Intake, Sales, or Appointment-setting environments.

  * Experience building certification programs, mentorship initiatives, career progression frameworks, and leadership development programs.

  * Background in instructional design, learning and development, organizational development, or corporate training.

  * Experience creating video-based, self-paced, instructor-led, and blended learning programs.

  * Experience developing manager training and performance improvement programs.

  * Experience working in a startup, high-growth, or rapidly scaling organization.

  * Certifications in Instructional Design, Learning & Development, Adult Learning, Coaching, Scrum, Agile, or related disciplines.

  * Extreme sense of ownership, pride and urgency- we move fast and are accountable to ourselves, our customers and our team. 



What Success Looks Like

The Training Manager owns the complete employee learning lifecycle, from onboarding through ongoing development. Success is measured not by training delivered, but by employee readiness, consistency, performance, and retention.



 New Hire Training & Onboarding 

  * All new hires complete onboarding, certification, and graduation requirements within established timelines.

  * New hires receive a consistent training experience regardless of trainer, start date, or training cohort.

  * Training classes are structured, organized, and delivered on schedule.

  * New hires demonstrate readiness before being released to production through documented assessments and certifications.

  * Agents are successfully transitioned into production teams with clear supervisor handoffs and performance expectations.



Performance & Development

  * New hires achieve expected quality and productivity metrics within established ramp periods.

  * Quality trends, recurring errors, and performance gaps are proactively identified and addressed through targeted training initiatives.

  * Refresher training and continuing education programs are delivered consistently.

  * Career development pathways support employee growth, internal promotions, and leadership development.



Training Program Ownership

  * Training materials, SOPs, certifications, knowledge bases, and assessments remain current and aligned with operational requirements.

  * New client launches, process updates, and operational changes are incorporated into training before impacting production performance.

  * Training programs scale effectively to support company growth and hiring demands.

  * Strong partnerships are maintained across Operations, Quality, and Leadership teams to continuously improve employee performance and client outcomes.



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

   * Onboarding & Graduation

         * 95%+ New Hire Training Completion Rate

         * 95%+ Training Completion Within Established Timelines

         * 90%+ Certification Pass Rate

         * 90%+ Graduation Rate

         * 100% Readiness Assessments Completed Prior to Production Release



Retention & Performance

         * 85%+ New Hire 30-Day Retention Rate

         * New hires achieve expected productivity and quality benchmarks within established ramp schedules

         * Measurable reduction in repeat QA errors month-over-month

          * 100% Completion of Required Retraining Initiatives



Program Management

  * Training materials updated within 3 days of approved process changes

  * 100% Training readiness for new client launches and operational rollouts

  * Monthly reporting on training completion, certification results, retention, quality trends, and development initiatives



Ownership

   The Training Manager is responsible for:

         * New hire onboarding and orientation

         * Curriculum development and maintenance

         * Training delivery and facilitation

         * Certification and graduation processes

         * Production readiness assessments

         * Transition of agents into operational teams

         * Ongoing employee development and career coaching

         * Refresher training and retraining initiatives

         * Training documentation and knowledge management

         * Measuring and improving performance outcomes after training



 Benefits & Perks 

At Juvo Leads, we believe great people deserve a great place to work. We're a fast-growing, fully remote team that values collaboration, accountability, and a positive work environment where your ideas and contributions matter.



Compensation & Schedule

  * Pay: $9.00 USD per hour

  * Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST

  * Some evenings and weekends will be required to support training initiatives within our 24/7 operation.

  * Bi-weekly payments via Wise



Premium Pay

  * Overtime: 1.5x hourly rate for hours worked over 80 in a pay period

  * Holiday Pay: 1.5x hourly rate for hours worked on designated company holidays after 8 hours worked



Paid Time Off

  * 10 hours of PTO accrued per month

  * Any unused accrued PTO will be paid out on the first payroll of the calendar year.



Health & Technology

  * $80/month HMO stipend

  * $200 Welcome Technology Bonus

  * $100 Annual Equipment Bonus



Why You'll Love Working Here

*  100% remote position

*  Opportunity to grow with one of the fastest-growing legal intake companies in the United States

*  Collaborative, supportive, and people-first culture

*  Comprehensive training documentation, SOPs, and knowledge management resources to set you up for success

*  Opportunity to make a meaningful impact by building and improving our training programs

*  Work alongside talented professionals across the United States and Latin America

*  A company that values innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and promoting from within



If you’re someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and knows how to stay ahead of the game, we want to hear from you.

Send your application to 
 and be part of our growing team at Juvo Leads! (as we do not check OLJ daily)

Please use the subject line “JUVO LEADS - CHAT INTAKE TRAINING MANAGER” when submitting your application. Thank you!

Our client roster has expanded to include legal tech founders, law firm partners and general counsel, and our scope of work has grown with it, from content strategy into thought leadership, speaking placements and event bookings. This role has real scope to grow alongside the business, both in terms of client portfolio and responsibility. We are looking for a Senior Business Development Executive to help us deliver all of it, brilliantly and consistently, while thinking several steps ahead of where we are today.



The Role



You will work directly with the founder to manage and deliver on a portfolio of legal industry clients, with the portfolio expected to grow as the business grows. This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do next. We need someone who spots the gap before it becomes a problem, who anticipates what a client will need before they ask for it, and who takes work off the founder's plate without being asked.



What you'll be responsible for



Client delivery



-Managing content strategy and delivery for each client, including one to two LinkedIn posts per week per client

-Running a 30 minute strategy and check-in call with each client on a regular cadence

-Being a responsive, professional point of contact on WhatsApp, delivering the highest standard of client care at all times

-Booking clients into speaking opportunities such as events, podcasts and webinars, including all the associated diary management, follow-up and admin this requires





Strategic support



-Supporting and executing LinkedIn profile raising strategies and personal branding work across the client base

-Contributing to and helping refine content pillars, tone of voice and positioning for each client

-Running or supporting LinkedIn advertising campaigns where relevant

-Flagging opportunities, risks and improvements before they are raised with you, not after





Operations



-Working across LinkedIn, Canva, the full Microsoft suite, Claude, Gmail, Google Meet, WhatsApp and Notion as core working tools

-Keeping client records, content calendars and speaking opportunity pipelines organised and up to date

-Managing multiple client deadlines simultaneously without anything slipping





What We Need From You



-Proven experience in business development, client services or account management, ideally within professional services, legal, or a comparable relationship-led industry

-Excellent working knowledge of LinkedIn, including organic content strategy, personal branding and LinkedIn advertising

-Confident, comfortable and professional in client-facing settings, including calls and written communication

-Strong administrative and organisational skills, particularly around diary management and coordinating speaking and event opportunities

-Comfortable working across LinkedIn, Canva, Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), Claude, Gmail, Google Meet, WhatsApp and Notion

-A genuine understanding of, and interest in, personal branding, profile raising and marketing strategy

-The judgement and discretion to handle confidential client information appropriately, given the legal industry context we operate in

-A self-starter mindset. You take initiative, think ahead of problems, and look for ways to make things run more smoothly, rather than waiting for direction





What Success Looks Like



Clients feel looked after, not managed. Deadlines are hit before they become urgent. The founder finds out about problems after you've already solved them, not before. Speaking opportunities are booked, tracked and followed up on without anything falling through the cracks. And the business runs a little more smoothly every month because you're in it.

* Understanding of internationalisation (i18next / react-i18next)



[Backend Awareness]



You will not write backend code, but you need to understand the systems you integrate with:



* Working knowledge of RESTful API design and HTTP conventions

[Agile / Scrum]

* Strong collaboration skills: proactive communication with Product Owner, Scrum Master, and cross-functional team members





[Nice-to-Have (Preferred Qualifications)]



The following are additional skills that would strengthen your candidacy. They are not required.



1. React Native / Mobile Development (Most Preferred)



* Experience with React Native and Expo for cross-platform mobile development

4. Angular & Legacy Project Maintenance

[Compensation & Benefits]

title: Shopify Plus Content and Catalogue Manager (B2B)
description:
Dear valued candidate, ** please answer the questions at the end after reading the job description ** 



The Shopify Plus Content & Catalogue Manager is responsible for the structure, accuracy, optimisation, and performance of the company’s Shopify product catalogue and collection architecture.

This role owns product data integrity, on-site SEO execution, internal linking logic, and digital merchandising to improve navigation clarity, search visibility, and conversion performance for B2B buyers.

• This is not a social media or paid ads role.

• This is not a developer role.

• This is a catalogue, structure, and optimisation role.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product & Catalogue Management

• Create, update, and maintain product listings (titles, descriptions, variants, images, PDFs).

• Expertise in bulk data management using Shopify CSVs or third-party tools (e.g., Matrixify/Excelify) to manage complex price updates, variant shifts, and mass metafield imports.

• Manage complex variant structures (single units, boxes, cartons, pallet layers).

• Maintain metafields, tags, and product data consistency.

• Ensure naming conventions align with SEO and B2B buying behaviour.

• Prevent duplicate content and structural inconsistencies.

2. Collection & Site Architecture

• Build and maintain logical collection hierarchies.

• Optimise category structures for clarity and search indexing.

• Implement smart collections and filtering systems.

• Maintain internal linking between related products and categories.

• Improve navigation for large SKU environments.

3. On-Site SEO Execution

• Optimise product titles, meta descriptions, and URLs.

• Manage redirects and canonical structures.

• Identify keyword opportunities relevant to B2B search intent.

• Collaborate on structured data/schema implementation (via apps or theme settings).

4. Digital Merchandising

• Optimise collection layouts.

• Improve cross-sell and related product logic.

• Support bulk purchasing strategy visibility (carton/pallet options).

• Manage B2B-specific catalogue logic, including quantity breaks, wholesale pricing tiers, and "Unit of Measure" displays (e.g., Price per Litre or Price per Pallet).

• Monitor product visibility and ranking within collections.

5. Performance Monitoring

• Use Shopify Analytics and GA4 to:

o Monitor product performance

o Identify underperforming collections

o Improve bounce and engagement metrics

• Propose structured improvements based on data.

6. App & Backend Management

• Manage Shopify apps (installation, removal, configuration).

• Test updates before publishing.

• Coordinate with developers where required (no coding required but must understand limitations).

Required Experience

• Minimum 5 years hands-on Shopify-focused experience (Required).

• Minimum 6–8 years total eCommerce experience preferred.

• Experience managing 1,000+ SKUs.

• Strong understanding of:

o Shopify product architecture & Metafields

o Collections (manual & automated)

o Redirect logic & Canonical handling

• Experience in B2B or technical product environments highly preferred.

• Strong structural thinking and taxonomy understanding.

Not Expected

This role does NOT include:

• Custom theme development

• Paid advertising management

• Social media management

• Advanced technical SEO (server-side issues)

• Full UX redesign ownership

•
 marketing automation

KPIs for This Role

1. Catalogue Accuracy & Integrity

• < 1% product data error rate

• 100% compliance with naming convention standards

• Zero duplicate URL or indexing conflicts introduced

• All new products live within agreed SLA (e.g., 48 hours)

2. SEO & Structure Improvement

• Increase indexed product pages without duplication

• Growth in non-branded organic traffic

• Improvement in category ranking positions

• Clean redirect mapping for discontinued products

3. Conversion & Merchandising Metrics

• Improvement in collection conversion rate

• Improvement in product page engagement time

• Increased cross-sell attachment rate

• Increased bulk/carton selection ratio

4. Operational Efficiency

• Time to publish new products

• Accuracy of bulk uploads (Zero-error imports)

• Clean metafield structure compliance

• Reduction in manual rework due to errors

1. Shopify experience: How many years of hands-on Shopify/Shopify Plus Admin experience do you have? Please list the Shopify areas/parts you have managed directly.

2. Bulk catalogue update: We need to update prices, product titles, and custom specification fields for 800+ Shopify SKUs. What method would you use?

3. Metafields / tags/catalogue structure: Give an example of how you have used Shopify metafields, tags, collections, variants, or product data fields to improve catalogue structure, filtering, SEO, or customer experience.

4. Product variants and channel management: How would you manage products sold in different sizes, fragrances, colours, pack quantities, or bundle options across Shopify and eBay while keeping the catalogue clean and easy to manage?

5. QA checklist: What checks would you complete before publishing a new product or bulk product update live on Shopify and eBay?

6. AI workflow: How do you use AI tools for eCommerce product content? Please explain your workflow from supplier data to final published copy.

7. Incomplete supplier data question: If supplier product data is incomplete, inconsistent, or unclear, what is your process for fixing it? What would you verify yourself, what would you not assume, and when would you escalate to the team?

Kills 99.9% germs. Hospital grade. Food safe. Can use everywhere. Dilute 1:10 or use direct for heavy stains. Lemon smell or no fragrance? Need check label. Works on urine smell and organic stains.”

title: Freight Booking Consultant
description:
About Us

We are a growing UK-based business seeking an experienced Freight Booking Consultant to support our ocean freight operations between China and the United Kingdom.



This is a hands-on consulting role for someone with extensive experience managing FOB ocean shipments directly with carriers. In addition to handling day-to-day bookings, you will play a key role in documenting our operational processes by creating a comprehensive Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) that can be used to train our internal operations team.



Trade Lane

Origin Ports

• Tianjin (CNTSN)

• Qingdao (CNTAO)

• Ningbo (CNNGB)



Destination Ports

• London Gateway (GBLON)

• Felixstowe (GBFXT)



Primary Carrier

• CMA CGM



Additional Carrier Platforms

• APL

• ANL

• CNC

• Maersk

• MSC



Key Responsibilities

1. Ocean Freight Bookings

• Manage end-to-end FOB shipment bookings through the CMA CGM Click & Book platform

• Prepare and submit carrier bookings accurately and efficiently

• Select suitable vessel schedules based on transit time, allocation availability, and operational requirements

• Enter and validate shipment details including:

-- Port of Loading (POL)

-- Port of Discharge (POD)

-- Container type and quantity

-- Cargo weight

-- Commodity descriptions

-- HS Codes

• Complete all shipping party information including Shipper, Consignee, Notify Party, Forwarder, Customs Broker, and D
 Party

• Verify freight payment terms and payment locations

• Review booking summaries and secure booking confirmations

• Utilize booking templates and reusable bookings where appropriate



2. Booking Management

• Monitor bookings from confirmation through vessel departure

• Process booking amendments, cancellations, and reconfirmations

• Coordinate cargo readiness against carrier cut-off schedules

• Monitor empty container release dates

• Track Verified Gross Mass (VGM) deadlines

• Monitor Shipping Instruction (SI) submission deadlines

• Resolve allocation issues and communicate directly with carrier booking teams when required



3. SOP Development

• Develop a comprehensive, step-by-step Standard Operating Procedure covering the complete China to UK booking workflow

• Capture screenshots of each stage within the carrier portals

• Create decision trees and workflow diagrams

• Prepare reference guides for carrier processes, booking statuses, and required documentation

• Document exception handling procedures and escalation paths

• Produce SOP documentation suitable for onboarding junior operations staff

• Continuously improve documentation as carrier processes evolve



Required Qualifications

Essential

• Minimum 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in ocean freight operations

• Extensive experience managing China to Europe or China to UK shipments

• Proven experience using CMA CGM Click & Book or equivalent carrier booking platforms (APL, ANL, CNC)

• Strong understanding of FOB Incoterms and associated operational responsibilities

• Experience with the following origin ports:

-- Tianjin (CNTSN)

-- Qingdao (CNTAO)

-- Ningbo (CNNGB)

• Familiarity with UK destination ports:

-- London Gateway

-- Felixstowe

• Experience managing multiple concurrent shipments

• Ability to interpret vessel schedules, ETDs, ETAs, and port cut-off timelines

• Previous experience preparing SOPs, work instructions, or operational documentation

• Excellent written and spoken English

Preferred

• Existing CMA CGM or APL customer portal access

• Established relationships with carrier booking teams

• Experience within a freight forwarding, NVOCC, or 3PL environment

• Knowledge of SOLAS Verified Gross Mass (VGM) requirements

• Understanding of UK import procedures and customs documentation

• Experience obtaining spot quotations through carrier procurement platforms such as SpotOn



Skills

Technical Skills

• CMA CGM Click & Book platform

• Carrier booking systems and e-booking platforms

• Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook

• Shipping documentation including:

-- Bills of Lading

-- Shipping Instructions

-- Dangerous Goods Documentation

-- MSDS

• Process documentation and SOP writing

• High level of accuracy and attention to detail

Soft Skills

• Excellent communication skills

• Strong organisational skills

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• Effective time management

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across carriers, suppliers, and freight partners



HIRING PROCESS

1. Application review - applications without a clear, specific summary of freight coordination experience will not advance.

2. A 15-minute interview, booked online. Concrete answers about real shipments - the lanes, the problems, and how you closed them - work best. May be followed by a second longer interview if needed.

3. Offer to the candidate who passes - a full-time position paid biweekly, every other Friday, in exchange for 9:00 to 5:00 UK Business Hours availability, Monday through Friday.



How to Apply

Submit your application through this form: 



The application form includes questions about your freight coordination experience, carrier platforms and systems you've worked with, cross-border shipping experience, availability, and expected rate.



Please note: Only applications submitted through the application form will be considered. Applications received without a completed form will not be reviewed.



Once you have completed the form, please send us a message with the subject line: Freight Consultant - [YOUR FULL NAME]

title: Supply Chain Manager – E-Commerce Dropshipping (High Volume, 3,000+ SKUs)
description:
ABOUT US



We are U-S Limited, a fast-growing e-commerce company operating multiple successful dropshipping stores across different European markets. We run our own brands with 3,000+ active SKUs sourced from a wide network of suppliers and agents. We move serious volume, and the complexity of our supply chain grows every week — more suppliers, more invoices, constant price changes, and more moving parts. We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager who can take full control of this and protect our margins.



THE ROLE



This is a high-volume, high-responsibility role. You will own our entire supplier and product operation. You will manage multiple suppliers, stay on top of every invoice and price change, and make sure our 3,000+ SKUs are always priced correctly, in stock, and fulfilled on time. A big part of this role is dealing directly with suppliers — and that means being a strong, direct communicator who verifies everything, questions incorrect charges, and holds suppliers accountable instead of accepting whatever they send. We need someone who is comfortable pushing back and negotiating hard to protect our pricing and margins.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Manage relationships with multiple suppliers and agents across different product categories

- Communicate directly and firmly with suppliers — verify pricing, question errors, and hold them to their terms

- Negotiate hard on pricing, volume discounts, shipping costs, and better terms

- Track, verify, and reconcile all supplier invoices — catch errors, double charges, and incorrect pricing before they cost us money

- Monitor price increases across all SKUs, flag them proactively, and calculate the margin impact

- Keep our 3,000+ SKU catalog accurate — cost prices, supplier links, shipping times, and stock status

- Monitor supplier performance: shipping times, defect rates, stock availability, and reliability

- Identify and resolve stockouts, fulfillment delays, and quality issues quickly

- Handle multi-currency cost tracking and understand the impact of FX on our margins

- Build and improve internal processes and systems to manage the supply chain at high volume

- Work directly with the CEO on sourcing strategy, cost optimization, and scaling decisions

- Take ownership and think proactively — anticipate problems instead of reacting to them



HARD REQUIREMENTS



- Proven experience managing supply chain or supplier operations for a high-volume e-commerce or dropshipping business — this is not a role for beginners

- You are used to working with large revenues, large order volumes, and large SKU catalogs (3,000+ SKUs)

- Experience managing multiple suppliers / Chinese agents at the same time

- A strong, direct communicator and hard negotiator — you are comfortable pushing back, questioning charges, and holding suppliers accountable

- Strong with numbers — you can spot pricing errors instantly, calculate margin impact, and reconcile invoices accurately

- Highly organized and detail-oriented — nothing slips through the cracks

- Analytical, proactive, and able to make decisions independently

- Comfortable working directly with the CEO in a fast-moving environment

- Strong written English



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience with European dropshipping markets

- Familiarity with Shopify, supplier portals, and fulfillment systems

- Experience building spreadsheets / systems for cost tracking and supplier management



WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU



- Full-time remote role

- Direct collaboration with the CEO

- High ownership and real impact on company profitability

- Opportunity to grow into a senior operations or supply chain lead role

- Long-term position inside a fast-growing e-commerce business



HOW TO APPLY



To apply, send us:



- Your resume

- A short summary (3–5 sentences) of your experience — include how many suppliers, how many SKUs, and what order/revenue volume you managed

- Proof of your experience and results (cost savings you achieved, systems you built, supplier issues you resolved, screenshots, case studies, or data)

- A short explanation of how you stay on top of hundreds of invoices and constant price changes without losing control



Important: This role is for experienced, high-volume operators only. No proof = no answer. We do not respond to generic applications or applicants who cannot show real experience with serious volume — it wastes both your time and ours. To confirm you read the full post, include the word "ANCHOR" in your application.

mber responsible for social media content, including short-form video, graphics, captions, and publishing across social channels. Your role is different. Your job is to ensure our marketing performs.

 sequences for different customer segments

 strategy, copy direction, and workflow logic. Website and lifecycle support may assist with building, formatting, QA, and launching the
s in HubSpot.

Reporting & Performance

title: Senior Video Editor — Long-Form VSL Ads for Meta (AI-Heavy)
description:
We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the health niche. We sell bamboo compression products — knee sleeves, ankle braces, gloves and socks — mainly to customers aged 50+ across Europe. Our flagship, DailyCompress, is a breathable bamboo knee sleeve designed to be worn through the night: it keeps circulation going while you sleep, eases swelling, and leaves the knee more supple and less painful by morning.



The role in one line



We need a senior editor who can build long-form VSL ads (2–4+ minutes) that take cold, unaware/problem-aware viewers and warm them all the way to purchase in a single watch — and who can generate realistic AI footage to bring those stories to life.



This is a senior position. We are not looking for beginners. You've already edited multiple long-form VSLs that have actually run on Meta, and you can prove it. If you're early in your journey, this won't be the right fit — and that's okay.



What we're really after



Our biggest opportunity is at the very top of the funnel — cold, "unaware" and "problem-aware" people who feel knee pain every day but don't yet know what's causing it. So our ads can't open by shouting "arthritis." The best ones:



- Lead with a felt symptom or everyday 
nt (that first stiff step out of bed)

- Reframe the problem by revealing a hidden cause the viewer never connected

- Bridge naturally to the solution, the proof, and the offer



Holding a cold viewer's attention for 2–4+ minutes is the single most valuable editing skill for this role.



AI is the most important skill (please read)



Just as critical as your editing: strong, proven experience generating realistic AI images and video. We rely heavily on AI to create believable scenes of older adults (50+) for our stories, and we work with tools like Higgs Field. If you can produce AI clips that actually look real, that is the single biggest advantage you can bring to this role.



What you'll be doing



- Edit long-form VSL ads (2–4+ min) that move cold audiences from "I have knee pain" to purchase

- Build narrative arcs: hook ? problem ? reframe ? solution ? proof ? CTA

- Edit for retention: tight cuts (every 2–4s), B-roll layering, captions, motion graphics

- Generate realistic AI images and video to support the story

- Work from clear customer avatars, scripts, and structured briefs



Requirements



- Senior-level: multiple long-form / VSL ads that have run on Meta — please share examples. Not a junior or entry-level role.

- Strong, proven AI image & video generation, including tools like Higgs Field — please share examples. This is the most important requirement.

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, or CapCut Pro (tell us which you master)

- Solid direct-response / performance-marketing and awareness-stage thinking

- Captions, motion graphics, B-roll selection, and color grading

- Fluent English

- 50+ demographic and/or health/wellness niche experience is a big plus



What we offer



- Full-time (8 hours/day), 6 days per week. long-term role in a fast-growing company

- Clear systems, avatars, scripts and structured briefings

- Direct collaboration with the creative strategist, and room to grow



How to apply



If you've read this carefully, start your message with the word "Editing" — applications that don't will be skipped. Then send us:



- Three (3) long-form video ads you've edited for unaware/problem-aware (top-of-funnel) audiences, each at least 2 minutes long. This is the most important part — we want to see how you hold a cold viewer and build a problem-aware story over a longer runtime.

- At least 3 realistic AI-generated scenes of older adults (50+) you've made for video ads, and the tools you used (e.g. Higgs Field).

- A few sentences on why you're right for this specific role — what makes you strong at long-form, problem-aware storytelling for an older audience, not just at cutting footage.

- Review our product: 
/knee-sleeve

- One long-form VSL concept (2–3 min) you would edit for a cold, unaware/problem-aware audience, with a short outline of the narrative arc.

- Your editing and AI tools, and your typical turnaround time per video.



Thank you.



Best regards,

Ralph

Cost Optimization: Identify ways to improve profitability by analyzing supplier costs, payment processing fees, and operational expenses.

- Financial Auditing: Conduct periodic checks on financial transactions, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and best practices.

Automation & Tech: Leverage tools like Xero, Dext, Expensify, Shopify, and Stripe to streamline financial processes and reporting.





Requirements:

-Experience in e-commerce finance management, specifically dropshipping (Shopify & Stripe required).

-Knowledge of Xero/QBO (or similar accounting software) for bookkeeping, reconciliation, and reporting.

-Experience o track expenses, invoices, and financial records.

-Familiarity with working with Chinese suppliers, including daily price verification, invoice reconciliation, and supplier payment processing.

-Ability to reconcile Shopify orders, Stripe payouts, and supplier payments efficiently.-

Multi-currency experience – understanding of exchange rates and international payment reconciliation.

-Strong analytical and attention-to-detail skills to verify order pricing and supplier invoices.

-Excellent English communication skills and the ability to liaise with suppliers, teams, and financial institutions.

-Previous experience in high-volume e-commerce transactions is a must.





What We Offer:

- Competitive salary based on experience.

- Opportunities for growth into leadership and management roles.

Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. title: Acquisitions Manager
description:
Our company 606 Home Buyers specializes in real estate marketing, training, and acquisitions. We serve investor clients as a consultation and coaching company in addition to managing marketing campaigns. We are in constant need of talented virtual assistants and we are seeking a highly organized, proactive Acquisitions Manager to take full ownership of our CRM and ensure no opportunity is left behind.



We are looking for a high-level Acquisitions Manager to take ownership of our deal flow, manage our lead managers, and close deals at a high level. Your core mission is to convert qualified leads into profitable deals, ensure accurate underwriting, and lead the acquisitions process from opportunity to contract. Following up with cold and older leads will be necessary - not just focusing on top-of-funnel hot opportunities. The majority of your leads will come from cold texting, RVM, and cold calling in the Midwestern U.S.



This is not an entry-level role. You must be experienced, decisive, and capable of operating independently without constant direction.





Key Responsibilities:



Acquisitions & Deal Closing

* Take over qualified leads and drive them to signed contracts

* Negotiate directly with sellers to secure favorable terms

* Re-negotiate deals when needed based on cash buyer feedback or counter offers

* Structure deals for maximum profitability



Underwriting & Valuation

* Perform accurate comp analysis (ARV, MAO, offer ranges)

* Ensure all deals meet company profit standards

* Validate numbers before contract execution

Creative Deal Structuring

* Structure and negotiate:

* Novations

* Seller financing / creative financing deals

* Other non-traditional deal structures

* Understand when and how to apply each strategy effectively

Team Leadership

* Manage and guide Lead Managers

* Ensure proper follow-up, CRM hygiene, and pipeline flow

* Provide feedback and improve team performance

Follow-Up & Pipeline Management

* Step in on warm/hot leads to push deals across the finish line

* Maintain consistent communication with sellers

* Ensure no high-quality opportunity stalls



Performance Expectations

* Consistently close deals that meet or exceed profit targets - 5 deals per month is our target

* Maintain high underwriting accuracy (tight comping, minimal errors)

* Effectively manage and elevate Lead Managers

* Keep pipeline moving — no bottlenecks



Requirements

* Minimum 3+ years of real estate acquisitions experience

* Proven track record of closing deals

* Strong experience with:

* Comparable sales (comps)

* Negotiation with sellers

* Contract-to-close deal flow

* Proficient in:

* Novations

* Creative financing (seller finance, subject-to, etc.)



Ideal Candidate Traits

* Self-sufficient & independent — you do not need hand-holding

* Proactive — you identify problems and solve them before being asked

* Strong decision-making ability under pressure

* Excellent communication and negotiation skills

* Detail-oriented with strong analytical ability

* Leadership mindset — can manage and improve others



Tools You Should Know How to Use

* CRM systems (InvestorFuse, REI Reply, or similar)

* Zillow, Redfin, PropStream, or similar for comps

* Dialers, texting platforms, and



Application Instructions (REQUIRED)

To be considered, you must complete ALL steps:



1. Submit a voice recording (1–2 minutes):

* Introduce yourself

* Describe your acquisitions experience and example of deals you negotiated successfully to closing



2. Include your 16Personalities (MBTI) type



3. Complete this application form:? 

Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



Who This Is NOT For

* Beginners or those without real deal-closing experience

* Anyone who needs constant supervision

* Candidates without experiencing generating accurate cash offers for land and SFRs



Why This Role Matters

You are directly responsible for revenue.? Your ability to analyze, negotiate, and close deals determines the success of the company. If you’re confident in your ability to control deals, lead people, and produce results, apply. We look forward to speaking with you.

Strong spoken English with clear and professional communication.

Ability to thrive in a high-volume outbound calling environment.

Strong organizational and time management skills.

Coachable, resilient, and performance driven.

Roofing or home services experience.

CRM experience.

Previous experience selling into the U.S. market.

Average approximately 40 outbound calls per hour.

Maintain detailed and accurate CRM documentation.

Schedule qualified roof inspections.

Conduct timely customer follow-up.

Contribute toward approximately 40 closed roofing projects per month.

Deliver an outstanding customer experience throughout the sales cycle.



Training, coaching, and ongoing development will be provided.



Compensation

Base Compensation: USD $500 per month.

On-Target Earnings (OTE): Up to USD $3,000+ per month through tiered, uncapped commissions.

Monthly payments issued on the 5th of each month.

Base salary is prorated for employees who begin mid-month.



Commission details will be discussed during the interview process.



Employment Details

Independent Contractor during the initial six-month onboarding period.

Full-time schedule (40 hours per week).

Monday through Friday.

Working hours approximately 9:00 AM–5:00 PM based on the assigned U.S. market.

Remote position open to qualified candidates worldwide.



Outstanding performers who successfully complete the initial contractor period will be considered for full-time employment with enhanced compensation and additional benefits as the campaign expands.



Equipment Requirements



Applicants must have:



Reliable computer or laptop.

High-speed internet connection (wired preferred).

Professional USB headset.

Quiet home office suitable for client calls.

Webcam for meetings and training.

Our Hiring Process

Application Review

Initial Screening Interview

English Communication Assessment

Sales Role Play

Final Interview

Offer & Onboarding



Our goal is to provide timely communication throughout the hiring process.



Applicant Privacy



Information submitted during the recruitment process will be used solely for evaluating your application and communicating with you regarding employment opportunities with ECSAT. Applicant information will not be sold or shared with third parties except as required to support the recruitment process or comply with applicable laws.



Join Our Founding Team



We are only hiring five SDRs for this initial launch.



Even if all current openings are filled, we encourage qualified professionals to apply. As the campaign grows, we expect to expand rapidly and will first consider candidates already in our recruitment pipeline.



If you're ready to build something meaningful, grow your career, and be rewarded for your performance, we'd love to hear from you.

The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented,

- Notify clients and internal staff of any attendance or scheduling issues.

- Uphold a high standard of customer service and professionalism in all client interactions.

- Generate and distribute scheduling reports as needed.

- Collaborate closely with the Scheduling Manager regarding caregiver performance, availability, and scheduling challenges.



Qualifications & Skills

- Proficient in computer use and digital tools, including Gmail and ChatGPT for communication and workflow efficiency.

- Experience using WellSky or similar CRM/scheduling platforms preferred.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Strong ability to multi-task, prioritize, and perform under pressure within tight deadlines.

- Demonstrated problem-solving and critical thinking skills with strong attention to detail.

- Self-motivated and capable of working independently while contributing to team success.

- Creative thinker with the ability to “think outside the box” to resolve scheduling challenges.

- Previous experience in home care, healthcare scheduling, or staffing coordination is a must.



Work Schedule & Environment

- Full-time and Part-time position; specific hours to be determined.

- Fully remote role requiring consistent access to both phone and computer systems.



Core Competencies

- Customer Service Orientation: Dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to clients and caregivers.

- Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrates professionalism, empathy, and clarity in all interactions.

- Time Management: Efficiently prioritizes and completes tasks in a dynamic environment.

- Adaptability & Flexibility: Adjusts easily to shifting priorities and changing client needs.

- Accountability & Dependability: Takes ownership of responsibilities and follows through consistently.

title: Executive Assistant to the Founder/Director
description:
Executive Assistant to the Founder/Director

WorkWise Auto Solutions | Remote (Philippines) | Full Time | Dayshift



I run WorkWise Auto Solutions, a North Queensland-based company providing Virtual Service Advisors, billing administration, automation, and reporting to Australian auto workshops. Most of our team is based in the Philippines and has been with us for years. I'm hiring an experienced Executive Assistant to run my day so I can stay focused on the decisions only I can make. This is a senior role, hired directly with no agency in between, for someone who has done this before at a high level and wants real trust and real ownership.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH YOUR ATTENTION



This is a direct hire, so what I pay is what you receive. You work with me, the owner, every day, not a rotating client list. My current assistant has been with me for three years and is moving into a bigger role, which is why this position exists, and it tells you how we treat the people we trust. You won't be guessing your way in either: you'll inherit a documented playbook covering how I work, my preferences, and my decision rules, and your job is to run it, then improve it.



WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS



This is not a task list job. I'm not looking for someone who books meetings and waits for the next instruction. I'm looking for someone who runs my inbox, my calendar, my travel, and my open loops so well that problems get solved before I know they exist. You'll know my business, my priorities, and my preferences better than anyone except me, and I'll trust you with all of it.



The standard is simple. When something enters your orbit, you own it to the finish. You bring me recommendations, not questions. If I hand you a task, you solve the whole situation the task points at, not just the line item.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- My inbox and calendar run proactively. I only see what needs me

- My travel. I'm regularly on the road across Australia, and you'll own all of it: flights, accommodation, itineraries, confirmations, and backup plans when things change, all arranged before I think to ask

- Daily monitoring of our platforms: Slack, client messages, community, and account balances. Anything unusual reaches me with a recommendation attached

- Chasing every open loop with the team, clients, and suppliers before I have to ask

- Briefs before every meeting that matters: who, history, and what decision is needed

- A weekly wrap of what's done, what's stuck, and what's coming

- Recruiting admin when we're hiring: posting, scheduling, screening logistics

- Documents and
s drafted in my voice

- The systems behind all of this. If we don't have one, you build it



That last point matters. The list above is the floor of this job, not the ceiling. The best person for this role will arrive with habits and systems I haven't thought of, and part of why I'm hiring a senior is so you can bring them.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- My inbox and calendar run proactively. I only see what needs me

- My travel. I'm regularly on the road across Australia, and you'll own all of it: flights, accommodation, itineraries, confirmations, and backup plans when things change, all arranged before I think to ask

s drafted in my voice

- The systems behind all of this. If we don't have one, you build it



That last point matters. The list above is the floor of this job, not the ceiling. The best person for this role will arrive with habits and systems I haven't thought of, and part of why I'm hiring a senior is so you can bring them.





YOU'RE RIGHT FOR THIS IF



- You have at least 5 years as an Executive Assistant, with real-time spent supporting a business owner, founder, or executive directly, ideally for Australian or US clients

- You've built systems for an executive that they never asked for, and you can tell me about them specifically

- You've managed travel for someone who is frequently on the move

- You're a vault. You'll know sensitive business and personal information and it goes nowhere

- You write clearly and naturally in English, and can match your tone to the reader

- You track everything. Nothing you own ever needs a follow-up

- You're comfortable across tools like Slack, Notion, and Google Workspace, and you pick up new systems fast. We run GoHighLevel, Xero, and Stripe; you don't need to know them yet, you need to be the kind of person who learns them in a week





PAY AND SETUP



- PHP 55,000 to 70,000 per month, depending on experience, and I'll go higher for someone exceptional, then we’ll reassess your rate for a raise after 6 months

- Paid leave and Philippine public holidays are respected

- Internet and equipment allowance

- Full-time, work-from-home. Preferably based close to Manila, as there may be occasional in-office days for face-to-face work when I am in the Philippines. This isn't fixed yet, and could average around one week a month, on an every-other-month basis.

- Dayshift aligned to Sydney (NSW) hours. Note that Australia has daylight saving, so from October to April your start time moves one hour earlier in Philippine time. If early starts are a problem, this isn't the role for you

- One month paid trial at full rate, so we both know it's right

title: VSL Video Editor (Experienced)
description:
About Us:

We're a fast-growing US health brand selling through direct response funnels. Our main marketing asset is long-form VSL (Video Sales Letter). We need a really good editor who understands this type of funnels and is willing to grow. It is a big growth opportunity in the company with a high salary if the person is the perfect fit. 



The Role:

You'll edit long-form VSLs (10 to 25+ minutes) and shorter ad creatives from scripts, voiceovers, and raw footage. This is not a "make it look pretty" job. It's a "make it convert" job.



What You'll Do:

- Edit full VSLs from script to final cut: hook, lead, and body

- Use pacing, b-roll, captions, sound design, and visual variety to maximize retention

- Source and create visuals using stock footage and AI tools (image generation, AI video, voice tools)

- Cut hooks and lead variations for testing

- Revise quickly based on performance data and feedback



What We're Looking For:

- Proven experience editing direct response VSLs or long-form sales videos (we will ask for examples, this is non-negotiable, UGC videos do not count here)

- You understand the structure of a VSL: what a hook does, what a lead does, why the body is built the way it is

- You think in retention: you know where viewers drop off and how to prevent it

- Comfortable with AI tools (nano banana, ElevenLabs, Higgsfield, Kling, Flow) and eager to learn new ones and always research what is new on the market

- Fast turnaround, organized, and responsive, you will need to be able to produce quantity and quality at the same time. We are not looking for a one time project. You will have to constantly learn what works with our audience and adapt.

- Hungry to grow: we want someone who wants more responsibility and better pay as the company scales, not a freelancer juggling 10 clients. Someone that is really invested and is not scared to do overwork if necessary.



Nice to Have:

Experience in the health/supplement niche

Has worked with Top brands in the US that do long form VSL



How to Apply:

Apply down below if you are selected you will be asked to complete a form where you will have to send us examples. Please do not apply if you think you are not a fit.
