title: Hiring: Audio Producer | Remote | $350
description:
Role overview



1. Audio generation:

- Pull approved scripts from Story Developer once finalized, no generating from drafts or unapproved versions

- Generate TTS narration using ElevenLabs (or approved alternative), following the locked voice profile for each channel and character

- Maintain a voice and preset library per channel and character so settings stay consistent across episodes, not regenerated from scratch each time

- Re-render any line, paragraph, or full file where output doesn't match the required tone, pacing, or pronunciation

- Apply basic audio cleanup where needed: leveling, noise reduction, removing unnatural artifacts from TTS output



2. Quality control (audio):

- Full listen-through of every file before submission, not spot-checks

- Catch and fix: mispronunciations, unnatural pacing or robotic delivery, inconsistent volume across a file or across an episode series, breath or glitch artifacts, voice drift between episodes

- Confirm narration tone matches the channel's voice guide (e.g. Heat Season's soft-spoken, unhurried, never-over-explains style)

- Flag and document any line where the script itself causes bad TTS output (run-ons, ambiguous emphasis, awkward phrasing) and route back to Story Developer rather than silently fixing the read



3. SRT generation and accuracy:

- Export an SRT file for every audio file, timestamps matched to actual narration delivery, not just script line breaks

- Self-check against a standard checklist before submission: no overlapping timestamps, text matches script line for line, no missing or duplicated lines, gaps within set tolerance

- Treat SRT accuracy as a hard requirement, not a quality nice-to-have. This is what Video Producer depends on to place image prompts correctly

- If Video Producer flags a sync issue after the file is in use, that package is pulled back, corrected, and resubmitted, and it does not count toward that day's completed output until fixed



4. File organization and handoff:

- Follow established naming conventions and Google Drive folder structure, matching the system used across editors and producers

- Submit both audio file and SRT together as one package per episode or segment, never partial handoffs

- Keep file versions clean, no "final_v2_actuallyfinal" naming, overwrite or clearly version-label



5. Reporting:

- Daily EOD report in Notion covering: number of packages completed, any files kicked back or reworked, any script issues flagged upstream, any recurring tool or voice-model problems

- Flag blockers same-day, not at the next status check. This role sits in the middle of the pipeline so delays compound downstream fast



6. Cross-role coordination:

- Story Developer: feedback loop on scripts that don't TTS cleanly

- Video Producer: primary downstream user of your output, responsible for catching real-world sync issues your self-check might miss

- Escalate recurring tool issues (ElevenLabs credits, voice model bugs, export failures) to ops rather than working around them silently



Out of scope:

- Writing or editing scripts (Story Developer's job, you flag issues, you don't rewrite)

- Image prompt generation or video assembly (Video Producer's job)

- Final approval on whether a voice fits a new character, that's a creative call made before the script reaches this role

title: Junior Social Media Manager
description:
We're looking for one person to join our team as a Junior Social Media Manager.



This is a full-time role, so if you're looking for side gigs or freelance work, this probably isn't the right fit.



You'll mainly be helping us manage our social media accounts by keeping content organized, scheduling posts, writing captions, researching trends, and coming up with content ideas. From time to time, we'll also ask for your input on what's working, what isn't, and what we can improve.



You don't need years of experience, but you should already have a good understanding of social media. If you're the type of person who notices trends early, enjoys creating content, or spends way too much time on Instagram, TikTok, or
, you'll probably enjoy this role.



We're looking for someone who:



Can commit to working full-time

Is organized and pays attention to details

Writes well in English

Is comfortable learning new tools and processes

Has a reliable computer and internet connection

Takes initiative instead of waiting to be told every little thing



Experience with Canva, CapCut, Meta Business Suite, or scheduling tools is a plus, but don't worry if you haven't used all of them before. We're happy to train the right person.



This isn't just about posting content. We want someone who's interested in learning how social media helps businesses grow. As you gain experience, you'll have more opportunities to contribute ideas, take on bigger responsibilities, and grow with the team.



If you'd like to apply, send us a short introduction, tell us about any social media pages you've managed.



We'll only be reviewing applications from candidates who are available for full-time work.

description:

Novantar S.A. is the exclusive worldwide sales agent for Antarctica21, a pioneering Chilean operator of Antarctic expeditions and the world leader in Antarctic Air-Cruises. The Company’s adventure tours combine the comfort and speed of a flight to Antarctica with a boutique expedition cruise in a wilderness setting.



The Opportunity 



We are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to join the Sales & Marketing team. The candidate must have at least three years of Business Development experience within the travel industry in South East ASIA ideally with a focus on the polar travel industry. He or she must have a keen desire to join a small, high-performing team that is passionate about delivering results.



The Role



The Business Development Manager, South East ASIA is responsible to generate revenue based on an annual sales plan from new clients and from an existing portfolio of travel agents and tour operators in the assigned markets. Through research, agent visits, product training sessions, and other promotional activities, the Business Development Manager ensures that assigned sales targets are met. He or she will encourage travel agents and tour operators to feature Antarctica21’s products prominently within their brochures, websites, and marketing activities.



Main responsibilities



Business Development Management



•        Research Travel Agents and Tour Operators in the assigned markets and profile potential new partners with audiences for the Company’s products.



•        Introduce the Company’s products to the prospective new partners and develop new business relationships in accordance with the Company’s annual sales plan.



•        Be intimately familiar with the product offers and marketing plan of the new partners to maximize the opportunities for exposure and revenue for Antarctica21. 



•        Support new partners with product training, marketing materials, and ideas for promotions to ensure that the Company’s products are featured accurately and in the best possible way.



•        Solicit, negotiate, and contract groups in the assigned markets.



 



 



Account Management



•        For each account in the assigned portfolio, build consensus and obtain commitment on annual passengers and productivity targets in accordance with the Company’s sales plan.



•        Review monthly revenue reports and hold regular productivity reviews with the assigned clients.



•        Gather intelligence about the assigned clients’ future plans with a view to shaping future offers and to maximize opportunities.



•        Ensure that the assigned accounts are kept up to date with changes in Antarctica21s product and offers.



Research, Planning, Analysis, and Administration



•        Assist the Commercial Director, in the production of annual sales plans for the South East ASIA market.



•        Using a monthly sales report by agent provided, maintain a monthly action plan.



•        Maintain an up-to-date summary of contact details for the key personnel at each account.



•        Maintain a summary of group and charter contracts.



•        Maintain a summary of special offers and conditions extended to assigned accounts.



•        Manage a business travel plan efficiently and within budget



•        Be intimately familiar with the offers of the competition.



•        Staying informed on the trends that shape the polar travel market and industry.



•        Carry out any other reasonable assignment that may assist in the smooth operation of the business.



 



Requirements





Minimum Required Skills and Knowledge



•        At least three years of business development experience within the travel industry in the South East ASIA, ideally with a focus on the polar travel industry.



•        A network of commercial relationships within the travel industry in the South East ASIA



•        A proven track record delivering assigned revenue targets.



•        Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with excellent command of the English Language.  



•        Experience with the consultative selling process, designing solutions for the mutual benefit of clients and the Company.



•        Familiarity with travel marketing channels and initiatives.



•        Persistence in the pursuit of objectives, with a demonstrated ability to take creative and pro-active actions to achieve goals.



•        Discipline, self-motivation, and proven experience working independently within set guidelines.



•        Proficiency with
, word processing, and spreadsheet applications.



•        Business travel experience.



•        Ability to accommodate frequent travel, including internationally.



 



 



Welcomed Additional Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

description:

About Us



At Helper Heroes, we’re on a mission to provide exceptional care and support to home care agencies in America. We believe in creating a true partnership where our employees act and feel like a true member of the American team they are matched with. Our goal is to help them create a compassionate, innovative, and efficient care experience for their clients and their families. To achieve this, we’re looking for a Helper Hero to join our team and help us shine even brighter!



About You



What sets us apart is YOU. You’re not just any virtual assistant —you’re a Helper Hero! If you’re passionate about making a difference, have a knack for organization, and thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment, you’re who we are looking for. If you’re the kind of person who loves tackling behind-the-scenes tasks with a smile, ensuring that our clients' caregivers and clients receive the best possible support, apply today!



Job Overview



We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Recruiter to support recruitment, caregiver onboarding, and administrative tasks for a growing home care business. This role is ideal for someone with experience in healthcare recruitment and a passion for

streamlining operations. You will work closely with the owner to alleviate their workload, enabling them to focus on business growth and client care.



Key Responsibilities



1. Recruitment & Onboarding:



- Manage end-to-end caregiver recruitment: screen applicants, schedule interviews, and coordinate orientation/training.

- Process onboarding documentation via ADP Workforce (e.g., electronic I-9s, employee handbook distribution).

- Track and ensure completion of state-mandated caregiver training (e.g.,via Active Insights).



2. Administrative Support



- Answer inbound calls during peak hours and manage voi
s/lead inquiries.

- Assist with client intake calls and referral source coordination.

- Provide general administrative support (e.g., scheduling, data entry).



3. Systems & Collaboration



- Utilize platforms like WellSky or Axiscare (training provided) to streamline workflows.

- Collaborate with the owner to refine processes and maintain organization.



Qualifications:



- Excellent written/verbal communication (fluent English).

- Strong organizational and time-management abilities.

- Proficiency with CRM systems,
 management, and cloud-based tools (e.g., Google Drive).

- Proactive mindset—anticipate needs before they arise.

- Proven experience in recruitment, specifically in healthcare or home care staffing.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with candidates and tea
mbers.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.

- Familiarity with recruitment platforms and CRM tools

- A positive attitude, sense of humor, and a passion for helping others.



Attributes of a Successful Helper Hero:



- Empathy: You genuinely care about people and want to make a difference in their lives.

- Organization: You’re a master of multitasking and can keep everything running smoothly.

- Communication: You speak impeccable English. You’re a clear and friendly communicator, both written and verbal.

- Problem Solver: You can see the big picture when resolving complex issues and follow through until you reach full resolution.

- Self Starter: You work effectively without supervision and follow processes precisely.

- Reliability: You’re dependable, punctual, and always ready to step up when needed.



Why You’ll Love Working with Us:



- Competitive Base Pay: $6.50/hr for the first 6 months. (Among the highest in the homecare industry)

- Make a Difference: You’ll play a key role in ensuring that clients receive the best care possible.

- Growth Opportunities: As we grow, so will you! There’s plenty of room for advancement and learning.

- Fun & Supportive Team: We’re a tight-knit group that values collaboration, compassion, and a good laugh.



Ready to Be a Hero?



If you’re excited about the opportunity to join our team, where you’ll be appreciated, have a sense of purpose and inclusion and are willing to help us create a brighter, more compassionate care experience, we can’t wait to hear from you! Apply today and let’s make a difference together.

title: Product Research Specialist
description:
Part-time (approximately 10 hours per week to start)

Compensation: $6–8 USD/hour, depending on experience, skills and performance during the test assignment.



This is more than a typical Product Research role. We’re looking for someone who can eventually help us build the system behind our product research process.



About Us



We are a growing Dutch e-commerce company selling on 
, one of the largest online marketplaces in the Netherlands and Belgium.



Our goal isn’t just to find winning products—we want to build a scalable product research system that consistently identifies great opportunities for our current wellness and intimacy brand and can later be applied to future product categories.



We’re looking for someone who wants to help build that system.



The Role



This role has two stages.



We first want to understand how you think and approach product research.



If we’re impressed, you’ll help us turn that knowledge into a structured, repeatable system that our company can continue using as it grows.

 marketplace.

 is a plus, but not required.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
ESTIMATED HOURS: On-call retainer / as-needed - NOT fixed hours, 5 hr/week (spikes during i
)



PAYMENT STRUCTURE (IMPORTANT -READ CAREFULLY):

- 50% paid in ETH (Ethereum), bi-weekly

- 50% paid in GMI token, vesting linearly over 18 months

- This is an aligned, skin-in-the-game structure

- If you want pure cash only, this role is NOT for you

- If you believe in Web3 and want long-term upside, keep reading



RESPONSE SLA: You must acknowledge any request or alert within 24 hours. Every time. This is the #1 requirement.





ABOUT US

Our team at Energi Core runs production blockchain infrastructure on AWS -EKS (Kubernetes), RDS databases, EC2 instances, RPC nodes, and indexers, across both mainnet and testnet environments. Our senior DevOps is excellent but overloaded. We need a blockchain-native engineer on standby to handle routine operations, catch problems early, and keep everything healthy.



We are past our build phase. We are not hiring someone to architect or refactor. We are hiring someone to WATCH, MAINTAIN, and FLAG.





WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Monitor RPC node health: sync status, peer count, block lag, reorg frequency

- Monitor indexer health: subgraph lag, indexing errors, data drift

- Watch RDS database pressure: CPU, connections, storage

- Monitor EKS pods, nodes, and load balancers across mainnet and testnet

- Triage alerts with blockchain-aware judgment (mainnet first)

- Run weekly cleanup: unattached EBS volumes, orphaned IPs, old snapshots, stale container images, old CloudWatch logs

- Enforce tagging, access control, and documentation standards

- Produce weekly and monthly infrastructure health reports

- Handle user onboarding and offboarding across GitLab, VPN, and AWS SSO

- Escalate production-critical or architectural issues to Senior DevOps with chain-aware context





WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

- No mainnet deploys, rollbacks, or architecture changes

- No validator key or signer operations

- No VPC, networking, or security group changes

- No IAM policy design

- No database migrations or schema changes

- No Terraform or Infrastructure-as-Code changes

- No mainnet i
 response (you escalate immediately)

- Nothing that touches wallets, trading paths, or revenue systems



HARD REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

We have learned the hard way that generic DevOps does not work for blockchain. If you do not have ALL of the following, please do not apply:



1. Minimum 2 years of hands-on production blockchain infrastructure experience at a crypto or Web3 company (not a hobby, not a bootcamp, not a side project)



2. Proven experience operating full nodes or RPC nodes in production -Geth, Erigon, Nethermind, Reth, or equivalent



3. Proven experience running indexers or subgraphs in production -The Graph, Subsquid, Ponder, or custom-built



4. Hands-on Kubernetes / EKS experience running stateful chain workloads



5. Strong AWS fluency -EC2, EBS, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, Cost Explorer (console AND CLI)



6. kubectl fluency -get pods, describe, logs, top, delete, exec



7. Dashboard literacy -CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus



8. Discipline to respond within 24 hours, every single time, without fail



9. Genuine comfort being paid 50% ETH and 50% GMI vested over 18 months





NICE TO HAVE (BONUS)

- Experience with EVM chains (Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Base, etc.)

- Validator operations or staking infrastructure exposure

- MEV infrastructure or block-building familiarity

- Helm, Karpenter, or Terraform (read-only is fine)

- Prior on-call rotations on blockchain infrastructure

description:

title: Digital Agency Project Manager
description:
### About the Role ###



We are a fast-moving digital marketing agency that builds and launches sales funnels, ad campaigns, and client deliverables at pace. We are hiring a Project Manager who will own our launch calendar, run our project management tool (Basecamp), and be the single person responsible for making sure every project ships on time — every time.



This is not a coordination role. This is an enforcement role. You will be the person who holds the team accountable, including contractors, staff, and the founder. If something is late, it is your problem to solve. If someone is a blocker, you name it and escalate immediately. If scope is creeping, you kill it.



If you are the type of person who sends polite follow-up messages and waits to be chased — this role is not for you.



### What You Will Own ###



**Launch Execution**

- Own the end-to-end launch timeline for every funnel and campaign project from kickoff to go-live

- Set a hard launch date at the start of every project and work backwards to assign every task, dependency, and deadline

- Enforce a one-working-week launch window from final approval to go-live — no exceptions without your sign-off

- Run daily check-ins on all active projects to surface blockers before they become delays



**Task Assignment and Briefing**

- Every task that leaves your hands is complete — the brief, assets, references, acceptance criteria, and deadline are attached before it is assigned

- No contractor should ever need to ask what is expected of them — if they are asking, that is your failure, not theirs

- Anticipate what each role needs before they ask for it and have it ready



**Basecamp Management**

- Maintain Basecamp as the single source of truth for all active projects — every task assigned, every deadline set, every update logged

- No task sits unassigned or without a due date

- Any overdue task is flagged within 24 hours and escalated if unresolved within 48 hours



**Team Accountability**

- Chase contractors and staff for deliverables without being asked — you do not wait for people to update you

- Escalate directly to the founder when a tea
mber is consistently missing deadlines or blocking progress

- Hold a weekly project review with the founder covering what launched, what is at risk, and what needs a decision



**Process Building**

- Document what worked after each launch and turn it into a repeatable checklist for the next project

- Identify recurring bottlenecks and fix them — you are expected to make the system better over time, not just run it

- Enforce scope freeze once a project enters its final launch week — no new additions without a formal scope change



### What We Are Looking For ###



**Non-negotiable:**

- Minimum 2 years of project management experience inside a digital marketing, creative, or performance agency — not adjacent to agency work, inside it

- You have personally managed launches involving copywriters, designers, media buyers, and developers simultaneously

- You write airtight briefs — people who receive your assignments do not need to follow up for clarification

- You are comfortable telling someone senior — including the founder — that they are the bottleneck, and you do it without drama

- Fluent written and spoken English



**Strong advantage:**

- Hands-on experience with Basecamp

- Familiarity with funnel builds, landing pages, or digital campaign workflows

- Experience managing remote or contractor-heavy teams

- You have built SOPs in a fast-changing environment where the process was still being figured out



### What You Are Not ###



- You are not an account manager — you do not manage client relationships

- You are not a task logger — you do not just update Basecamp, you enforce it

- You are not a yes-person — your job is to protect the launch date and the quality of every brief that goes out, not to make everyone comfortable



### The Interview Process ###



How to Apply

Step 1: Apply via our application form here: Application Form ? 

Step 2: Upon submission, you will receive an
 with a written assessment. Read the instructions carefully and follow them exactly — this is the first test.

The assessment requires you to complete 4 scenario-based questions, track your time, and submit your completed document. Candidates who do not follow the instructions will not be reviewed.



### Summary ###



Our funnels are launching late — not because the team can't execute, but because the way work gets assigned and managed is broken. Tasks go out incomplete. Contractors spend more time asking for clarification than doing the work. Assignments come in late and the launch window shrinks before anyone has started.



We need someone who is meticulous to the point of obsession. Someone who cannot hand off a task without every brief, asset, and dependency already attached. Someone who reads a project plan and immediately spots the gap that everyone else missed. Someone who treats a missing deadline the same way others treat a fire alarm.



If you are the kind of person who has a system for everything, gets irritated when processes are sloppy, and takes it personally when a project ships late — this role was built for you.



*We move fast and the process changes as we learn. You will be building the system while running it. If that sounds like chaos to you, this is not the right role. If that sounds like exactly the problem you want to own — apply.*

title: Finance Manager – Working Capital & AR
description:
We're an established Australian wholesale and distribution business based in Melbourne. We're growing steadily and looking for a sharp, reliable finance professional to take ownership of our accounts receivable, cash flow, and working capital.



This isn't a bookkeeping role. We already have the transactional side covered. We need someone who can think about cash. Where it's tied up, how to release it faster, and how to make our finance operations run cleanly.



The role: 



You'll own the cash side of our business. Specifically:



Accounts receivable & collections





Manage the debtor ledger end-to-end in Xero

Proactively follow up outstanding invoices via
 and phone

Build and maintain strong working relationships with our customers' AP teams

Escalate genuinely problematic debtors with a clear recommendation

Report weekly on aged receivables, DSO, and collection performance





Cash flow management





Maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast

Flag issues early. Don't wait for problems to become crises

Track variances between forecast and actual and explain the drivers

Manage our debtor finance / invoice finance facility (drawdowns, reconciliations, reporting to the financier)

Support trade finance arrangements with suppliers

Identify opportunities to reduce our cash conversion cycle - inventory, payables, receivables





Systems & process improvement:





Improve how Xero integrates with our other systems (inventory, CRM, payment platforms)

Automate manual reconciliation and reporting where sensible

Document processes as you build them



About you



Must-haves





5+ years' experience in AR, credit control, or finance operations for businesses billing in AUD, USD, or GBP

Strong hands-on Xero experience (please tell us specifically what you've done in Xero)

Excellent written and spoken English, you'll be
ing and phoning Australian customers directly

Comfortable, professional, and firm when chasing overdue payments

Solid Excel / Google Sheets (formulas, pivots, basic modelling, not just data entry)

Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for customer calls





Nice to have





Accounting degree or CPA (Philippines)

Experience with invoice finance / debtor finance facilities (e.g. Octet, Waddle, Marketlend, Timelio, or similar)

Wholesale, distribution, or importing industry background

Experience integrating Xero with inventory or CRM platforms (Cin7, Unleashed, Dear, Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)

Prior experience working directly with Australian businesses





What we offer



13th month pay in December

Paid Philippine public holidays

Clear pathway to full-time within 6–12 months, with a salary increase at that point

Genuine ownership of a function. You're not one of ten people doing the same thing

Direct access to the owner. Decisions get made quickly

Long-term role. We're building a team, not filling a short-term gap





How to apply



Please send:





A short cover note (5–10 sentences) telling us why this role suits you specifically. Generic applications will be skipped

Your CV



A 3–5 sentence answer to this question:

Our 13-week cash flow forecast shows a $80,000 shortfall in week 6. What are the first three things you'd look at, and what levers would you consider pulling?"

title: Packaging Graphic Designer (Full-Time)
description:
Packaging Graphic Designer (Full-Time)

Join Our Creative Team



We're looking for a talented Packaging Graphic Designer to join our growing creative team on a full-time basis.



Our company develops premium consumer products sold internationally under multiple brands. We pride ourselves on creating packaging that not only looks exceptional but also enhances the customer experience and reflects the quality of our products.



We're looking for someone with proven experience designing packaging for commercial products who understands both creative design and the technical requirements of print production.



This is a full-time position (8 hours per day) and is ideal for someone who enjoys transforming ideas into visually striking, production-ready packaging.



What You'll Be Doing



As our Packaging Graphic Designer, you'll be responsible for designing packaging across a wide range of consumer products.



Your responsibilities will include:



Designing retail packaging from concept through to final production artwork.

Creating box designs, labels, sleeves, inserts, hang tags, product wraps, and other packaging materials.

Developing packaging layouts that align with each brand's visual identity.

Creating original graphics, icons, and supporting design elements where required.

Working from existing brand guidelines while also creating new concepts from scratch.

Preparing artwork for commercial printing and manufacturing.

Applying dielines accurately and ensuring all artwork fits production specifications.

Working closely with our product development team to refine and improve packaging designs.

Making revisions based on feedback while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

Software Requirements



Applicants should be proficient in the Adobe Creative Suite, including:



Adobe Illustrator

Adobe Photoshop

Adobe InDesign

Adobe Acrobat

Essential Skills



We're looking for someone with:



Proven experience designing retail packaging

Strong understanding of packaging layout and composition

Excellent typography skills

Experience working with dielines

Strong understanding of print-ready artwork

Excellent attention to detail

Ability to create visually appealing packaging that stands out on retail shelves

Strong organisational and time management skills

Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

Bonus Skills



Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:



Commercial print production

Foil stamping

Spot UV

Embossing and debossing

Specialty packaging finishes

Working with rigid boxes and folding cartons

Colour management (CMYK, Pantone)

Preparing production-ready artwork for manufacturers

What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate is someone who:



Has a strong eye for design and visual balance

Takes pride in producing polished, professional work

Is highly organised and detail-oriented

Can interpret creative briefs and bring ideas to life

Works independently while meeting deadlines

Enjoys creating premium products that customers love

Portfolio Requirement (Mandatory)



Applicants must provide a detailed portfolio showcasing packaging design work.



Your portfolio should demonstrate experience designing packaging such as:



Product boxes

Folding cartons

Retail packaging

Labels

Product sleeves

Inserts

Hang tags

Consumer product packaging



Applications without a portfolio demonstrating commercial packaging design experience will not be considered.



Please note that portfolios consisting primarily of logos, branding, social media graphics, flyers, or marketing materials without packaging examples will not be considered suitable for this role.



Employment Details

Full-time position

8 hours per day

Paid public holidays

13th month pay

Competitive salary based on experience

How to Apply



To help us identify applicants who pay close attention to detail, please begin your application with the words:



"Packaging First"



Include the following with your application:



A link to your portfolio

A brief introduction about yourself

The Adobe applications you use most frequently

Examples of packaging projects you've designed

A short explanation of your role in each project (concept, layout, artwork, production, etc.)



We look forward to reviewing your portfolio and welcoming a talented Packaging Graphic Designer to our growing creative team.

About Solve Outsource



At Solve Outsource, we help ambitious businesses achieve growth by providing outsourced Accounting, Bookkeeping, Payroll, and Management Accounting services.



As our client portfolio continues to expand, we're looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Onboarding Accountant to join our growing team. This role plays a critical part in ensuring new clients experience a smooth, professional transition to Solve Outsource and are set up for long-term success.



If you enjoy problem-solving, working with diverse businesses, and making a direct impact from day one, we'd love to hear from you.



About the Role



The Onboarding Accountant is responsible for managing the end-to-end financial onboarding process for new clients. You will work closely with clients, previous accountants or bookkeepers, and internal stakeholders to ensure accounting records are accurate, reconciled, and ready for transition to our ongoing service delivery team.



You will serve as the bridge between a client's previous accounting function and their new outsourced finance department with Solve Outsource.



Key Responsibilities:



Manage client onboarding projects from commencement through completion.

Review accounting records and assess the current state of client accounts.

Complete catch-up bookkeeping and accounting work when required.

Reconcile bank accounts, debtors, creditors, VAT, payroll, and balance sheet accounts.

Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies, errors, and historical issues.

Liaise with clients and third parties to obtain required information and documentation.

Support accounting software migrations and data transfers.

Work across cloud accounting platforms including Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, and other industry-specific systems.

Ensure onboarding procedures, documentation, and checklists are completed accurately and on time.

Prepare detailed handover notes for the ongoing client service team.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of onboarding processes and best practices.

Build strong client relationships and create an outstanding first impression of Solve Outsource.



Skills & Experience



Essential Requirements



Must be a  CPA

Must have 3-5 years related experience in Accounting and leading a team

Strong understanding of bookkeeping, management accounting, and financial controls.

Experience using accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks, and/or Sage.

Excellent reconciliation and analytical problem-solving skills.

High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Strong organizational and time management abilities.

Ability to manage multiple onboarding projects simultaneously.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.



What Makes This Role Different?



This is not a traditional bookkeeping or accounting position.

Every client is different. Every onboarding project brings new systems, industries, challenges, and opportunities to learn.

One week you could be onboarding a hospitality business, the next a construction company, wholesale distributor, golf club, or professional services firm.



This role is perfect for someone who:



Enjoys variety rather than repetitive processing work.

Loves solving problems and untangling accounting issues.

Takes pride in delivering accurate and complete financial records.

Enjoys learning new technologies and accounting systems.

Wants exposure to a wide range of industries and business models.

Thrives in a fast-paced, growing organization.



Why Join Solve Outsource?

Work with a growing and ambitious outsourced finance business.

Gain exposure to diverse industries and accounting systems.

Develop both technical accounting and client-facing skills.

Join a supportive, collaborative, and high-performing team.

Enjoy genuine career progression opportunities as the company grows.

Make a meaningful impact on client success from day one.

mber.

mber.

title: Full-Time Recruiter — Weekend Availability Required
description:
# Philippines-Based Virtual Assistant



## Caregiver Recruiting, Pipeline Management & Homecare Operations



**RN-Owned Private-Pay Homecare Agency | Massachusetts | Long-Term Role**



We are a fast-growing, RN-owned private-pay homecare agency based in Massachusetts looking for a highly dependable, organized, and accountable **Philippines-based Virtual Assistant**.



The **main focus of this role is caregiver recruiting and pipeline management**.



Your job is to help find caregivers, screen them, follow up with them, collect documents, schedule interviews, track their progress, and move them through the hiring pipeline quickly and consistently.



This is not a casual VA role. This is a repetitive, fast-paced recruiting and operations support role. We need someone who can stay focused, follow up constantly, update trackers accurately, and make sure applicants do not fall through the cracks.



You will work directly with ownership and will be expected to communicate quickly, stay organized, and take ownership of the caregiver pipeline.



---



## Main Responsibility: Recruiting & Pipeline Management



Your primary responsibility is to keep the caregiver recruiting pipeline moving every day.



This includes:



* Messaging new caregiver applicants

* Calling or texting applicants

* Screening caregivers

* Scheduling interviews

* Following up with applicants who do not respond

* Tracking every applicant’s status

* Following up on missing documents

* Following up on references

* Making sure onboarding steps are completed

* Updating the recruiting tracker daily

* Keeping ownership updated on who is ready, who is delayed, and who needs follow-up

* Pushing qualified caregivers forward until they are hired, rejected, or removed from the pipeline



The goal is simple: **move caregivers through the pipeline without delay.**



This role requires repetitive follow-up. You cannot be afraid to message people multiple times, keep lists organized, and stay on top of every applicant.



---



## Important: Monitoring & Accountability



Because this is a remote position, all paid working hours are monitored through time-tracking and activity-monitoring software.



You must be fully comfortable with:



* Clocking in and out accurately

* Screenshot monitoring during paid hours

* Activity tracking and idle-time tracking

* App and website usage monitoring

* Working only on assigned company tasks during paid time

* Responding quickly on WhatsApp during scheduled hours

* Providing updates throughout the day

* Being honest and transparent about internet, power, weather, or personal issues



If you are not comfortable being monitored while working, this is not the right position.



We are not looking for someone who disappears during work hours, delays responses, gives vague excuses, or needs to be chased for basic updates.



---



## Daily Work Expectations



This role involves repetitive but important work every day.



You will be expected to:



* Review new applicants

* Send recruiting messages

* Follow up with caregivers

* Update trackers

* Confirm interview times

* Check who is missing documents

* Push applicants to the next step

* Report progress daily

* Communicate immediately when there is a problem



This position is best for someone who is disciplined, consistent, and comfortable doing the same important tasks every day.



---



## Secondary Responsibilities: Operations Support



Although recruiting is the main focus, you may also help with basic homecare operations, including:



* Helping with schedule confirmations

* Supporting shift coverage communication

* Sending caregiver reminders

* Updating spreadsheets and trackers

* Organizing documents and digital files

* Helping with care-related administrative tasks

* Supporting communication with caregivers, families, and internal tea
mbers

* Researching vendors, caregivers, software, supplies, or other business needs as assigned



---



## Requirements



* Must be based in the Philippines

* Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

* Prior experience in recruiting, staffing, healthcare, homecare, or VA work preferred

* Homecare experience is strongly preferred

* Excellent written English

* Good spoken English

* Reliable computer and internet connection

* Backup internet plan preferred

* Must be comfortable using WhatsApp, Google Sheets, trackers, and time-tracking software

* Must be comfortable with repetitive follow-up work

* Must be responsive during scheduled hours

* Must be looking for a long-term role



---



## Non-Negotiables



You must be able to:



* Show up on time

* Respond quickly on WhatsApp

* Keep the recruiting tracker updated

* Follow up without being reminded

* Move applicants through the pipeline daily

* Communicate before there is a problem

* Give updates if internet, power, or weather issues happen

* Stay active and focused during paid hours

* Be honest about what was completed and what was not completed

* Accept monitoring and accountability during all paid hours



If you frequently have attendance issues, internet excuses, delayed responses, or difficulty staying focused during remote work, please do not apply.



---



## This Role Is a Good Fit If You:



* Enjoy recruiting and follow-up work

* Like clear systems and expectations

* Are comfortable with repetitive tasks

* Are organized and detail-oriented

* Are disciplined and dependable

* Want stable, long-term work

* Are comfortable being monitored during paid hours

* Want to grow with a serious company



---



## Application Instructions



To apply, please send the following:



1. A short summary of your VA, recruiting, staffing, healthcare, homecare, or administrative experience



2. Confirmation that you are based in the Philippines



3. Confirmation that you are available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours



4. Confirmation that you are fully comfortable with time tracking, screenshot monitoring, activity tracking, and app/website monitoring during paid hours



5. Your expected hourly rate



6. Your backup plan if your internet or power goes out during a scheduled shift



7. A short answer to this question:

   **How do you keep applicants moving through a recruiting pipeline?**



8. A short answer to this question:

   **How do you handle repetitive follow-up work every day without losing focus?**



9. A short answer to this question:

We are looking for someone honest, dependable, responsive, and serious about long-term work.

title: Sales Development Representative (Cold Calling / Appointment Setting)
description:
READ FIRST — THIS IS A VOICE-FIRST ROLE

Your spoken English is the product. It must sound clear, natural, and easy for American ears, close to a neutral or American accent. This is the single most important requirement. Everything else on this list is secondary. If your accent is closer to conversational Filipino than American, this specific role won't be the right fit, and that's completely okay.



About Always Answer

We build custom voice, text, and chat agents for small, owner-operated home service businesses (plumbing, HVAC, pest control, cleaning, and more). Our agents answer every inbound call in seconds, sound human, qualify the caller, and book the job. 24/7/365. We're an early-stage company with a clear mission: small business owners should never miss a call that could turn into a paying customer.



The Role

We're hiring a Sales Development Representative to make outbound calls to small home-service business owners across the United States. Your one job: get them interested and book a short discovery call with our founder. You are the first voice these owners hear, so warmth, clarity, and confidence on the phone matter more than anything.



What you'll do

- Call business owners from curated lead lists we provide

- Open warm, build quick rapport, and spark interest in what we do

- Book discovery calls onto the founder's calendar (that's the goal of every call)

- Log call outcomes and notes accurately

- Calls are recorded for coaching and improvement



What we're looking for

- Clear, warm, easily understood English that sounds natural to American ears. This is the #1 requirement, see the note at the top.

- Real comfort and confidence on the phone. You like talking to people.

- Reliability and consistency. You show up for every scheduled call block.

- Sales or appointment-setting experience is a plus but not required if the phone presence is there.



Working Hours

This is a part-time role (~25 hours/week) on a set call schedule in US Central Time (Dallas, TX). Reliable availability during scheduled US CST call blocks is required.



Compensation

- Base $550–$700 USD/month depending on experience (part-time, ~25 hrs/week, paid directly).

- Plus a bonus for every discovery call that shows up. Strong setters clear $900+/month total.

- Room to grow into full-time as we scale.



TO APPLY — voice recording required (no exceptions)

Record ONE audio clip, about 60 seconds, in two parts:



Part 1 — read this script exactly as written:

"Hi, is this the owner? My name is [your name], and I'm calling from Always Answer. The reason for my call is simple, we help busy home-service owners like you make sure you never miss a call that could turn into a paying customer, even when you're on a job or after hours. I'd love to grab fifteen minutes with our founder to show you how it works. Do you have your calendar handy?"



Part 2 — then, in your own words (about 20 seconds): tell us why you'd be great on the phone for this role.

Upload it somewhere shareable (Vocaroo or Google Drive) and paste the link in your application. Applications without this recording will be deleted unread.

title: Recruitment Consultant - Work from Home + High Earnings
description:
ARE YOU A WORLD-CLASS RECRUITER WHO WANTS TO WORK FROM HOME & EARN GREAT $$$





This is an amazing opportunity to work from home and earn great money - way above the industry average through great commissions and incentives. 

  

We are a Recruitment Agency in Australia/NZ with big dreams, a solid vision, and a track record of success, and we would love to have interesting, loyal, and hard-working people come along on the journey to success. At the 
nt, we recruit in the most exciting niche ever - ACCOUNTANTS (they're not that bad...really!) in Australia and NZ and will be expanding across the world. With the right people who are hungry and want to grow, we can build teams under you and grow quite rapidly, expanding to other countries, including the US, Canada, Singapore, and other parts of the Asia Region.

  

Due to high demand in the current market, we are looking for talented and experienced 360 Agency Recruiters in South Africa to join our team on a full-time basis. This is a very dynamic role and will suit someone who is curious, has a very strong work ethic, is hungry for success, is super honest, and loves helping people succeed in their careers.

  

You will run your own desk and play an integral part in identifying and attracting the best talent in the market and providing exceptional candidates to our clients.

  

Your responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:

- Dealing with clients and candidates (cold/warm calling clients and candidates)

- Talent sourcing of prospective candidates from websites, LinkedIn, internal databases, and market mapping

- Interviewing candidates, formatting resumes, writing up summaries for clients, and doing reference checks

- Develop the right sourcing strategy to fulfil the open positions

- Plan and execute targeted talent Nurturing Programs

- Attend to general inquiries, screen and shortlist potential candidates

- Keeping regular contact with current and prospective talent and following up for future positions

- Understand trends in the marketplace and industry that present recruiting opportunities for the business

- Update CRM and databases

- Daily/Weekly recruitment progress reporting



Are you our ideal candidate? YOU DEFINITELY ARE if you have the following attributes:

- Have a minimum of 2+ years of experience recruiting in an agency environment, working with Western candidates and clients (US/AU/NZ/CA/UK/UAE/SG) - ideally in the white-collar space - where you proven experiences that can be corroborated by your manager that you can pick up the phone and cold call hundreds of clients and/or candidates

- Prepared to work hard, enjoy life while making great money

- Very success-driven and goal-oriented - we want a culture of success, and we are only prepared to hire hungry, self-driven winners

- You know how to build rapport and consult in an honest and engaging way that adds value

- Have a high level of Attention to Detail & Very Organised & Very Conscientious/Disciplined

- Must have a track record of success in your life and ability to execute and get $##t done no matter what

- Genuinely want to be involved in building the business and make it better every year - proactive individuals who strive for personal improvement

- Loyal & Intelligent - we want people who will be the fabric of this organisation for many years to come, and if you want to be involved in the management of the company, then even better. Recruitment is not something you give a go, unless you’re prepared to put in the hard yards and make it a career for at least 3-5 years – don’t bother applying – it’s too hard of a job to just “give it a go”, nor am I interested in crackheads “giving it a crack”

- Open-minded, tough, very intelligent, extremely resilient, curious and lots of fun

- People with high commercial acumen who know how to consult, not just hard sell.

- Ability to create quick and strong rapport with clients over the phone and a willingness to contribute as part of a collaborative and dynamic team

- If you have an Accounting, B2B, or Corporate background, even better. 

- You have experience using your outstanding communication skills to build strong relationships and achieve sales targets, and you are very comfortable picking up the phone for strangers!

- Excellent communication skills with fluency in the English language (10/10) - written and speaking!

- Available for at least 40 hours per week (Monday to Friday Australian/NZ/US/Asia Hours), and you understand that agency recruitment is not a 9-5 role. 

- Have your own Desktop/Laptop/Monitor with access to reliable and high-speed internet

- Can do attitude and result-driven

- Ability to work autonomously and with minimal supervision

- Over and above that, we value people who are loyal and with high integrity. Being trustworthy is the highest priority for us. If you lie to us even once, even a white-lie, you’re out!

- Excellent computer literacy skills and proficiency in sourcing tools like LinkedIn, Boolean, and Job boards and proven AI skills

  

What we found from having hired and trained many recruiters in the past, this role WILL NOT WORK for you if: 

- You DON’T have solid corporate experience (i.e.: you’ve never worked in an office environment).

- You DON’T have a stable job history (i.e.: your CV looks worse than that of a job-hopping kangaroo). Btw: stable means at least 3-5+ years in most roles.

- You're AFRAID of working hard continuously - the role requires discipline and hard work to begin with, afterwards gets much easier, you will be doing long hours, your candidates are sometimes only available after hours, so you need to be available when they are.

- You're AFRAID of picking up the phone and speaking to strangers on a daily basis and using your skills and intelligence to influence them

- You're NOT WILLING TO COMMIT 3-5 years to this because this role takes time to master and pays growing dividends the longer you're in it

- You are NOT COACHABLE & INTELLIGENT - there is a lot of training provided, so you need to want to learn and, more importantly, implement

- You're NOT A TEAM PLAYER - this is a team effort and will require everyone to contribute to the success of the business

- You are NOT COMMITTED TO YOUR SUCCESS, LACK DRIVE IN LIFE (people in the same role for 10 years do not excite me, I want to see growth), and if you HAVE OTHER BUSINESSES OR PRIORITIES on the side that will distract you - won’t work - just trust me 

- You are NOT AN HONEST & TRUSTWORTHY INDIVIDUAL - you will get full transparency, honesty, and integrity fro
 with a lot of support and training - but I expect honesty and integrity from you as well

- You are a VERY SOCIAL person who needs people physically around them all the time for banter and camaraderie - because you will struggle to work from home.

- You have TOO MANY OBLIGATIONS IN LIFE and cannot commit to making this role work. This role is very time demanding and mentally taxing, for example all the mothers in our company said they love the flexibility we offer but it may be challenging to do this role with young kids who need attention and are not relatively independent.

- You are NOT STRUCTURED, DISCIPLINED OR SELF-DRIVEN - once again, you’ll be working from home autonomously with no boss breathing down your neck and no one else to inspire you to work hard. You need to be someone who plans their day the night before, plans their week on a Sunday night and ensures they’ve ticked everything off

- You are NOT TECH SAVVY and know your way around social media, Boolean search, AI tools, and the ability to research 

- You get TOO FRAZZLED when $##t happens - and in recruitment it happens a lot because our ‘product’ is a human being that…well, you know the rest! If you’re not the type that’s used to being able to fix things, problem solve your way out of a quagmire of you know what, pick yourself up and dust yourself off and then use all your influencing skills and charm to get everyone back on track, well then you might struggle to feed the kids at the end of the month 

- You are NOT INTELLIGENT - and that means emotionally and intellectually - yes, recruitment can be easy, but EASY = EQ + IQ!



Wow...that’s a long list! (Are they recruiting people or trying to keep them from applying?)



It’s the latter! Just trying to be transparent so we don’t waste each other's time. I would love to hire all of you and be the biggest company in the world but the problem is, you will want to leave after 2-4 weeks when you realise it doesn’t work for you, I would have wasted weeks on training you, my wallet would be lighter, your heart will be broken - so I’m just saving us a lot of pain. 



That's it! (Can’t believe you’ve read this far) 



The rest is up to you. But we want winners on board. If you're interested (and you should be - I mean WHO wouldn't want to recruit accountants from home and have fun doing that while making the big bucks!!!)



If this sounds like the role for you, we would love to hear from you! Apply ONLY BY sending an
 to 
 with your CV and cover letter (must use the word giraffe in the cover letter) with answers to the following questions:



- Explain why you think you're suitable for the role and ensure you match the criteria (job stability, agency experience, cold calling experience etc..)

- What sort of recruitment have you done in the past - type of roles, locations, achievements when it comes to billings etc.…?

- Your current/most recent salary (MUST state in PHP per month, will be verified so don't make it up)?

- Minimum expected salary?

- What other skills can you bring to the role that make you a better candidate than others for this opportunity?

- If you are currently employed, why are you looking to leave your current role?

- What hours can you work?

- Internet speed/reliability?

- Have you read the full ad and followed all the instructions in the ad?
